_comment: Which edit classes Quick Fix may apply silently. silent = replaced without asking; review_only = shown in the Review panel first; off = never produced. A class is silent only where the gate sets show G1, G2 and G5 within target; 'gate' records the evidence (candidate edits and how many were wrong, over bench/typed_gate.jsonl, an extended set of 1,606 cases built from KeyReed's own docs and correction references, and lane B's bench/quickfix_gate.jsonl, scored by bench/score_typed.py and bench/score_quickfix.py, 17 November 2026). A class's 'contexts' replace its policy in single app categories; the top-level 'contexts' cap every class in an app category (the lower of the two wins). Shipping default is review everything: quick_fix_always_review is on, so silent here only means the user can switch silent replacement on for that class.

spelling.gate: Windows spell checker + word-list and one-suggestion filter: 90 edits, 6 wrong (technical terms such as uipi, onnx; companys -> company in a gold that keeps it); G1 everyday 0.69% against 0.3%, so review only

rule_pronoun_i.gate: 15 edits, 1 wrong; too few to prove G2

rule_esl.gate: 35 edits, 1 wrong (at the earliest -> as soon as possible is a rewording)

capitalisation.gate: email and document: 25 edits, 0 wrong; chat 23 of 23 wrong, notes 4 of 9 wrong, code 3 of 5 wrong (lower-case text is deliberate there)

capitalisation_upper.gate: the model turned im into IM; whole-word upper case is never wanted

doubled_word.gate: 24 edits, 0 wrong, in chat, document, email and notes; G1 0 on all clean sets

article.gate: 15 edits, 0 wrong; too few to prove G2

punctuation.gate: no edit of this class survived the guards in any set

agreement.gate: 242 edits, 8 wrong; G1 technical 0.11% (1 of 878), G2 0.83% on 600 seeded sentences but 6.7% on lane B's 30 agreement cases

confusable.gate: 48 edits, 3 wrong, 2 of them in chat

inflection.gate: 70 edits, 66 wrong: noun number and verb -s changes without a cue (plan C2 restriction)

inflection_cued.gate: 2 edits, 1 wrong; too few to prove G2

replacement.gate: 15 edits, 13 wrong: multi-word rewrites (are process -> is processing)
